title: Wholesome Warm Middle Eastern Egg Noodles
description: Rich, creamy, and comforting, this wholesome Middle Eastern dish features al-dente egg noodles.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the flour and eggs. Add the salt.
Gradually add the ghee while mixing with your hands until it forms a dough.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes to bring out its flavor.
Divide into six balls and flatten each ball gently.
Roll out one flattened ball at a time, gradually rolling thinner as you go.
Cut noodles from rolled-out dough with a knife or pasta cutter. Repeat with remaining dough balls.
Cook the noodles in boiling salted water for about 3 minutes until al-dente.
Drain and set aside to cool slightly.
